results: Two disposable verified email identities authenticate for ownership and operator checks
Visitors can read shared posts while private posts stay isolated to their owner
RLS rejects forged owners and preserves comment/reaction ownership and uniqueness
Anonymous callers, ordinary verified email users, metadata spoofing, and self-grants have no staff privilege; an admin temporary teacher grant works
Read-only viewing and optional nickname save create no anonymous identity; public UI exposes profile and operator account controls only
A failed first anonymous signup creates no identity and preserves the open reply and text for retry
Unsubmitted comments autosave privately on this device, survive reload, and do not create an identity or public comment
First guest reply creates its identity lazily; a failed write preserves the open thread, text, and stable retry identity
Refreshing retains the same guest identity and ownership of its earlier reply
A separate browser sees the guest reply, persists its own reply, and retains it after reload
First guest insight survives the auth callback and saves its source anchor without an auth modal; its official source opens in the selected language
First reaction is single-flight: one anonymous signup and one owned reaction
Switching accounts in one browser purges prior private records and loads only server-backed staff capability
The separate operator account supports staff capability checks and password recovery
Guest and operator browser workflows have no runtime errors
